en: Sepia-toned portrait postcard of a young man in profile, wearing a dark suit and white shirt, looking to the right. The style is an early 20th‑century studio photograph. Dark ink handwriting, likely a dedication and signature, is scrawled across the lower half of the image. In the bottom left corner, the photographer's imprint reads "EUGEN SCHIFFNER / DRESDEN / Bismarckplatz 8."
